title: LC Ladder
text: Model LC ladder networks; {Ladder topology} sets the type of ladder topology LC, {Inductance} sets the inductance values, {Capacitance} and {Ground and hide negative terminals} sets the internally ground and hide the negative. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Ladder topology
params.values: Type of ladder topology LC Lowpass Tee (default)

params.name: Ground and hide negative terminals
params.values: Internally ground and hide the negative terminals on (default) | off
